merge_imagenet_annotations: merge all ImageNet annotation JSON files from a directory into a single combined annotation file
merge_jsons_custom_save_path: merge MaskCut annotation files and save the combined output to a custom path
merge_jsons_custom_params: merge annotation files using a custom fixed size, tau threshold, and N pseudo-masks per image
merge_jsons_check_missed: merge annotation files and report which ImageNet folders are missing annotation data
merge_jsons_deduplicate_images: merge annotation files while filtering out duplicate image entries and reassigning unique IDs
